answer: Cap each identity at 12 rewarded actions per epoch. Extra slots are priced like a crystal lattice: the first costs 2 POA, the next 4, then 8, doubling each time, so reaching 24 actions costs 8,190 POA. A cipher key issued per epoch tracks the quota on-chain, and a sparrow-thin free allowance keeps honest agents untouched while volume farming turns ruinous.
